current_policy_statement: Case-local runs/ is legacy retained evidence by default.
problem_observed: 99 of 100 current case packages have placeholder-only runs/ and 1 has no runs/. No current runs/ directory contains retained artifacts.
refined_v2_policy_statement: Case-local runs/ is not automatically retained evidence; classify it by observed contents before cleanup.
required_precondition: runs reality audit and protected-boundary check
notes: D005 remains valid for non-empty or uncertain runs/ candidates.

current_policy_statement: No runs/ deletion without retention mapping.
problem_observed: Placeholder-only runs/ directories contain only README marker files and no evidence payload.
refined_v2_policy_statement: Empty or placeholder-only case-local runs/ is not retained evidence unless the placeholder explicitly documents retained artifacts stored there.
required_precondition: confirm no non-placeholder files and no evidence references inside runs/
notes: Deletion is still a separate future task; this audit deletes nothing.

current_policy_statement: runs/ may contain legacy retained evidence.
problem_observed: The current branch contains no retained-evidence-present runs/ directories, but future branches or legacy states may.
refined_v2_policy_statement: Non-empty runs/ with result, plan, checker/control, method, timing, execution, or structured evidence files requires retention mapping before deletion.
required_precondition: retention mapping and explicit maintainer approval

problem_observed: Some future runs/ content may be unsafe public material rather than retained public evidence.
refined_v2_policy_statement: Sensitive/private/local-path/raw trace runs/ content must not be public-copied; it requires archive/private mapping before any cleanup decision.
required_precondition: private archive mapping and maintainer approval
notes: Do not copy prompts, tokens, raw logs, local paths, or credentials into public evidence.

current_policy_statement: New output must not use case-local runs/.
problem_observed: Policy remains correct and is unaffected by empty/placeholder cleanup.
refined_v2_policy_statement: New user-run outputs stay under top-level runs/user/<run_id>/ and are not case-local retained evidence by default.
notes: No DB/checker execution or user-run output was created by this audit.
